title: Petition to Save Mass Effect Dev BioWare to Be Considered by Canada's Government

title: Opinion: Hey, That Hellraiser: Revival Game Is Pretty Good
summary:
Liam finds fun in AA horror.

For as much as I love the horror genre, I've never seen a Hellraiser film. If they're as fun to watch as Hellraiser: Revival is to play, though, then maybe I need to catch up.

Since we've got The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time and GTA 6 right around the corner (I'm now playing the former), I haven't wanted to start a big game that requires a serious time investment. With a 10-hour playthrough for the Platinum Trophy (which I did earn), this new Hellraiser game seemed like the perfect fit.

title: PS5 Closing in on 100 Million Sales as Gradual Drop-Off Continues
summary:
That's another 2.6 million PS5 consoles sold.

Sony sold another 2.6 million PS5 consoles during the second quarter of its 2026 fiscal year, bringing the total number of systems sold to 97.9 million.

It should surpass the 100 million sales milestone by the end of the next fiscal report, but the downward trend in sales has continued. PlayStation sold four million PS5 machines during the same quarter of its last fiscal year, confirming 1.4 million fewer systems were sold in the quarter just gone.
